style: Speak softly and gently, with a smile in your voice. Keep the delivery light and even: do not stress or punch individual words. Warm, friendly and relaxed.

lines.say: Meet Edward: an AI assistant for your mail, calendar, bills and to-dos.
Just ask, in plain words.
It checks your calendar, mail and bills, and tells you what matters.
It writes your email, too. Here's a reply to Sam, drafted for you. And nothing is sent until you say so.
Anything that changes something asks you first. Lunch with Jamie? One click, and it's in your calendar.
Reminders arrive on time, even when Edward is closed.
And the privacy guard: card and account numbers are removed before anything reaches the AI.
It keeps watch, too: your next trip, with the weather and when to leave.
The week ahead.
And before each event, the people and emails about it.
New mail arrives sorted: what needs you, and what's worth knowing.
Bills are found in your email, each one checked for fraud.
Your calendar: agenda, week and month, across all your accounts.
Lists live in Google Tasks, so they're on your phone too.
It remembers what you tell it, and forgets when you ask.
Ask for a picture, and it paints one.
It runs on your ChatGPT plan, or your own OpenAI key.
And you can talk to it.
Personal Google accounts only, never work ones.
Private by design: there is no Edward server.
Edward. Free, open source, for Windows and Mac.
